title: Amazon sets the stage for its first Prime Day in June since 2021
title_zh: 亚马逊将于 6 月举办自 2021 年以来的首个 Prime Day
summary: Amazon announces dates for its annual Prime Day summer savings event.
summary_zh: 亚马逊宣布了一年一度的 Prime Day 夏季优惠活动的日期。

title: Blue Origin launch pad repairs could take 'serious time', NASA chief tells CNBC
title_zh: NASA 局长告诉 CNBC，蓝色起源发射台的维修可能需要“认真的时间”
summary: Damage to a Blue Origin launch pad from the spectacular explosion of the company's giant New Glenn rocket ‌during a test firing of its engines last week will "take ‌some serious time" to repair, NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman told CNBC on Monday.
summary_zh: NASA 局长贾里德·艾萨克曼 (Jared Isaacman) 周一对 CNBC 表示，蓝色起源公司的巨型新格伦火箭在上周的发动机试射过程中发生了壮观的爆炸，该公司发射台的损坏将“需要一些严重的时间”才能修复。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures slip as US-Iran tensions weigh on AI optimism
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克期货下跌，因美伊紧张局势打压人工智能乐观情绪
summary: US stock futures slipped as investors weighed uncertainty over Iran talks alongside the latest developments in AI.
summary_zh: 由于投资者权衡伊朗谈判的不确定性以及人工智能的最新发展，美国股指期货下跌。

title: Wall St ends higher, boosted by tech gains, US-Iran peace hopes
title_zh: 受科技股上涨和美伊和平希望推动，华尔街收高

title: Top market stories to watch Tuesday, June 2
title_zh: 6 月 2 日星期二值得关注的热门市场故事
summary: Asking for a Trend Host Josh Lipton shares the top stories to keep an eye out for on Tuesday, June 2, including key earnings reports and the latest from Computex in Taiwan.
summary_zh: 寻找趋势主持人 Josh Lipton 分享了 6 月 2 日星期二值得关注的热门新闻，包括重要盈利报告和台湾台北国际电脑展的最新动态。

title: CoreWeave-Tied Data Center Seeks $850 Million Junk Bond Sale
title_zh: CoreWeave 关联数据中心寻求 8.5 亿美元垃圾债券出售
summary: (Bloomberg) -- A data center tied to CoreWeave Inc.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——与 CoreWeave Inc. 相关的数据中心。

title: Tesla's Optimus faces new threat as OpenAI enters robotics
title_zh: OpenAI 进军机器人领域，特斯拉 Optimus 面临新威胁
summary: Yahoo Finance Senior Autos Reporter Pras Subramanian joins Market Domination Overtime to discuss Tesla's (TSLA) new robotics competition in OpenAI (OPAI.PVT).
summary_zh: 雅虎财经高级汽车记者 Pras Subramanian 加入 Market Domination Overtime 讨论特斯拉 (TSLA) 在 OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) 中的新机器人竞赛。

title: There's risk in AI concentration, but stock prices are 'justified'
title_zh: 人工智能集中化存在风险，但股价“合理”
summary: June is finally here and US stocks (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) are feeling awfully festive, all three of the major indexes notching new records in the first trading day of the month.
summary_zh: 六月终于来了，美股（^DJI、^IXIC、^GSPC）气氛热烈，三大股指在本月第一个交易日均创下新高。

title: Nvidia Is Taking On Intel and AMD With AI Chip for Computers
title_zh: Nvidia 正在通过计算机人工智能芯片挑战英特尔和 AMD
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Nvidia Corp. is entering the PC market with a new chip aimed at loosening the stranglehold of Intel Corp.
summary_zh: (彭博社)——英伟达公司正在凭借一款新芯片进入个人电脑市场，旨在放松英特尔公司的束缚。
